docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
Attribute Arguments

  • <argument> - Required Argument
  • {optional} - Optional Argument
Tool Attribute Description Applies Usage AUTO_COLLECT automatically teleports items into the player's inventory GLOBAL AUTO_COLLECT AUTO_SELL automatically sells item in tool inventory(requires vault) GLOBAL AUTO_SELL DROP_BOOST increases the amount of items dropped GLOBAL AUTO_COLLECT DROP_ITEM drops an item when activated GLOBAL DROP_ITEM EXPERIENCE_MULTIPLIER makes the tool gain experience faster GLOBAL EXPERIENCE_MULTIPLIER:<multiplier> POTION_EFFECT gives the player a potion effect while holding the item GLOBAL UNBREAKABLE:<true/false> UNBREAKABLE prevents the item from losing durability GLOBAL UNBREAKABLE:<true/false> REPLANT_SAPLING replants saplings when the bottom-most block of a tree is broken AXE REPLANT_SAPLING:{chance} TIMBER breaks all logs instantly AXE TIMBER:<max-logs>:<destoy-leaves>:{chance} AREA_HARVEST Harvests crops in an area HOE AREA_HARVEST:<radius>:<chance> BOUNTIFUL_HARVEST generates extra crops HOE BOUNTIFUL_HARVEST:<multiplier>:<chance> CHAIN_HARVEST destroys crops in a snake like manner HOE CHAIN_HARVEST:<max_blocks>:<chance> CROP_FORTUNE increases the amount of crops dropped by crops HOE CROP_FORTUNE:<amount> FERTILE_TOUCH upon harvesting a crop, nearby crops have a chance to advance in growth HOE FERITLE_TOUCH:<power>:<radius>:<max_crops>:<chance> HARVESTER harvests any crop type instantly HOE HARVESTER:<true/false> INSTANT_REGROWTH chance to instantly regrow a broken crop HOE INSTANT_REGROWTH:<chance> REJUVENATING_PULSE creates a circle that grows nearby crops when activated HOE REJUVINATING_PULSE:<power>:<radius>:<duration>:<chance>:<cooldown> REPLANT_SEEDS Automatically replant seeds if they are in the player's inventory HOE REPLANT_SEEDS:<chance> REQUIRE_MATURE when true, allows a harvester tool to only break fully grown crops HOE REQUIRE_MATURE:<true/false> BLACKSMITH restores durability while mining PICKAXE PLACEHOLDER BLASTING destroys all blocks in a radius PICKAXE BLASTING:<radius>:{radius} DESTROY_ORES when true, the blasting tools will break ores PICKAXE PLACEHOLDER FORGE restores durability to all items in inventory PICKAXE PLACEHOLDER GEOLOGIST chance to discover bonus minerals when mining stone PICKAXE PLACEHOLDER SMELT_ORES automatically smelts ores when broken PICKAXE PLACEHOLDER VEIN_MINER mines all ores in a vein PICKAXE PLACEHOLDER

docs.title: Commands & Permissions
docs.text: Command Explanation Permission /journeyman help displays available commands journeyman.help /journeyman give <player> <tool-id> gives player a tool from the configuration journeyman.give /journeyman get <uuid> used to obtain a tool from its uuid (can be found in tools.yml) journeyman.get /journeyman edit <uuid> opens the editor for a specific tool journeyman.edit /journeyman inspect inspects the current tool being held journeyman.inspect /journeyman inspect <uuid> inspects a tool from id journeyman.inspect.others /journeyman id displays the uuid of the current tool being held journeyman.id /journeyman admin opens the journeyman admin GUI journeyman.admin /journeyman remove <uuid> deletes an instantiated tool journeyman.remove /journeyman list lists all tool definitions from the config journeyman.list /journeyman setxp <uuid> <xp> set a tool's experience journeyman.setxp /journeyman setxp <xp> sets the experience of the current tool being held journeyman.setxp /journeyman setlevel <uuid> <level> set a tool's level journeyman.setlevel /journeyman setlevel <level> sets the level of the current tool being held journeyman.setlevel /journeyman wipe <uuid> wipes a tool's progression journeyman.wipe /journeyman attributes displays all attribute definitions journeyman.attributes /journeyman disable <attribute> disables an attribute journeyman.disable /journeyman enable <attribute> enables an attribute journeyman.disable /journeyman reload reloads the plugin journeyman.reload /journeyman version displays the plugin version journeyman.version

docs.title: effect-settings.yml
docs.text:
# all effect settings are GLOBAL and apply to every tool that has the effect
BLASTING:
  drop-items: true
  optimized-dropping:
    enabled: true
    radius-start: 11
  require-correct-tool: false
  blacklisted-blocks:
    - BEDROCK
    - END_PORTAL_FRAME
    - BARRIER
    - COMMAND_BLOCK
    - LOCKED_CHEST
    - SPAWNER
    - TRIAL_SPAWNER
    - VAULT
    - REINFORCED_DEEPSLATE
  whitelisted-blocks: []
VEIN_MINER:
  blacklisted-blocks: []
  whitelisted-blocks:
    - COAL_ORE
    - DEEPSLATE_COAL_ORE
    - IRON_ORE
    - DEEPSLATE_IRON_ORE
    - COPPER_ORE
    - DEEPSLATE_COPPER_ORE
    - GOLD_ORE
    - DEEPSLATE_GOLD_ORE
    - REDSTONE_ORE
    - DEEPSLATE_REDSTONE_ORE
    - LAPIS_ORE
    - DEEPSLATE_LAPIS_ORE
    - DIAMOND_ORE
    - DEEPSLATE_DIAMOND_ORE
    - EMERALD_ORE
    - DEEPSLATE_EMERALD_ORE
    - NETHER_QUARTZ_ORE
    - NETHER_GOLD_ORE

docs.title: levels.yml
docs.text:
rewards:
  DEFAULT_BLASTING:
    level-upgrades:
      enabled: true                     # set enabled if you want your item to upgrade with level increase
      levels:
        10:
          - "MATERIAL:STONE_PICKAXE"    # use material for tool type
          - "BLASTING:5"                # use tag for upgraded effect, this is a replacement value not increment
          - "ENCHANTMENT:EFFICIENCY:1"  # define enchantments for upgrades like this
        25:
          - "MATERIAL:COPPER_PICKAXE"
        50:
          - "MATERIAL:IRON_PICKAXE"
        75:
          - "MATERIAL:DIAMOND_PICKAXE"
        100:
          - "MATERIAL:NETHERITE_PICKAXE"
  DEFAULT_HARVESTER:
    level-upgrades:
      enabled: true    # set enabled if you want your item to upgrade with level increase
      levels:
        10:
          material: STONE_PICKAXE   # use material for tool type
          radius: 5                 # use tag for upgraded effect, this is a replacement value not increment
        25:
          material: COPPER_PICKAXE
        50:
          material: IRON_PICKAXE
        75:
          material: DIAMOND_PICKAXE
        100:
          material: NETHERITE_PICKAXE
